sourcesContent:
app TypedImagesProgress
use std {WorkflowDefinition,WorkflowInput,ImageRequest}
use std {ImagesV1 as Images} from=deployment.comfyui
Given
 Job { label:text="Images", revision:int=0, request:delivery(Images.submit)?, cancellation:delivery(Images.cancel)?, reconciliation:delivery(Images.reconcile)? }
 ProgressNotice { delivery:text }
 policy Job read=members fields=label,revision,request.id,request.progress.state,request.progress.outputs,request.progress.sequence
 policy Job read=owner fields=label,revision,request.id
When
 ## Every original progress notification retains its real delivery identity.
 scenario progressed on=Images.submit.progressed
  do
   create ProgressNotice {delivery=event.delivery_id} as notice
   for job in Job as row where row.request?.id==event.delivery_id and row.label=="Cleanup" limit=1
    send Images.cancel {source=job.id,revision=job.revision} as cancellation
    set job {cancellation}
 crud Job by=members fields=label
 ## The receiving member supplies a real finalized workflow artifact.
 scenario generate(job:Job,graph:file,validation:text,prompt:text,revision:int,accept:bool) by=members
  do
   let workflow=WorkflowDefinition {graph,prompt=WorkflowInput {node="6",key="text"},negative=WorkflowInput {node="7",key="text"},width=WorkflowInput {node="5",key="width"},height=WorkflowInput {node="5",key="height"}}
   let value=ImageRequest {source=job.id,revision,workflow,validation,prompt,negative="",width=512,height=512,max_outputs=2,max_duration=30s}
   send Images.submit {value} as attempt
   set job {request=attempt,revision}
   require accept
 scenario stop(job:Job) by=members
  do
   require job.request!=null
   send Images.cancel {source=job.id,revision=job.revision} as cancellation
   set job {cancellation}
 scenario reconcile(job:Job) by=members
  do
   require job.request!=null
   send Images.reconcile {source=job.id,revision=job.revision} as reconciliation
   set job {reconciliation}
Then
 page / title="Image jobs"
  require members
  form Job.create
  list Job empty="No image jobs"
   text row.label
